description: Calculate monthly GOSI (social insurance, التأمينات الاجتماعية) contributions for employee and employer in Saudi Arabia, including the new-law annuity rates for people first registered from 3 July 2024. Web version: https://irfanaslam.io/tools/saudi-gosi-calculator

first_registered.description: When the employee was first registered with GOSI. Default before_2024_07_03.

housing_in_kind.description: True if the employer provides housing instead of an allowance (counts as 2 months' basic a year).

month.description: Contribution month YYYY-MM, default this month (new-law rates rise each July).

name: saudi_gosi_contribution
title: Saudi GOSI contribution
